product_metadata.title: PurpleEssences Fall Maple Leaves Table Runner, Autumn Thanksgiving Kitchen Dining Table Decoration for Indoor Outdoor Party 14x108 Inch - Vibrant Autumn Leaves
features: Fall Collection Table Runner Made of 100% Cotton Handwoven in a Weight and Texture Perfectly Suited for the Fall Season.

MEASURES 14”x108” IN SIZE: Our dining table runner is is 14-inches wide and 108-inches long. When laid centered and lengthwise, our runner is long enough to fit any standard size table comfortably and yet have enough cloth or material hanging over the edges.
High-quality table linen to enhance your table setting; Perfect for rustic, vintage or country look.

COORDINATING PLACEMATS: Pair with our matching placemats to create the foundation for a fun, casual dining experience. This table runner and placemat set can be used for table décor, dressers, sofa tables and coffee tables. It is perfect for everyday dinners, parties, holidays, picnics, brunches, and barbeques.

Machine wash on gentle cycle and lay flat to dry for stress free care. Sometimes the fabric doesn't lay flat after shipping. Use a warm iron with steam and the wrinkles will come right out leaving you with a perfectly flat and crisp table runner!

PurpleEssences offers an assortment of quality home and kitchen products including tablecloths, table runners, cloth napkins, placemats, dishtowels, oven mitts and potholders; Visit our PurpleEssencesStore to explore more.
